- Description: HEIC/GPS extraction fix — diagnose, implement, merge, live-verify (Sep 3–5)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/398
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/905

  Details:
  Full lifecycle of the HEIC upload + GPS extraction fix for the autopilot:
  
  1. DIAGNOSIS: Root-caused broken HEIC handling — both conversion sites called macOS-only `sips`, which does not exist on the Linux EC2 autopilot box, so HEIC uploads (e.g. Fazenda Bom Sucesso GPS-bearing originals) were never decodable. Verified on-box + against real iPhone 12 Pro Max HEIC.
  
  2. PR #398 (truesight_autopilot): Replaced sips with exif-preserving pillow_heif converter (convert_heic_to_jpg) in qr_scanner.py + main.py; declared pillow_heif dep. Local gate passed (compileall/ruff/format/pytest 129 passed) + real-HEIC smoke test proving GPS EXIF survives conversion.
  
  3. PR #905 (agentic_ai_context): Fixed docs — vision pipeline diagram now says pillow_heif cross-platform, preserves GPS EXIF (was "(macOS sips)").
  
  4. PR #399 (truesight_autopilot): The point of the task — GPS extraction + wiring: extract_gps_from_image() (EXIF GPS IFD → S/W-aware decimal degrees + altitude + capture timestamp); /chat/upload surfaces GPS in LLM content; telegram_adapter.py adds .heic/.heif to image_exts (they were silently dropped), converts HEIC→JPEG before OCR, surfaces GPS + captured time in attachment summary. 4 new hermetic tests; full suite 858 passed (only pre-existing env PAT failure, unrelated); merged after CI green (test + smoke).
  
  5. DEPLOY + LIVE VERIFICATION: Confirmed running service on merged commit; uploaded the real Fazenda Bom Sucesso HEIC to the live /chat/upload — pipeline fired (pyzbar/Grok/OCR) and GPS was extracted into the live session log: GPS -3.0942, -52.095181 / Altitude 132.8 m / Captured 2026:09:02 22:21:12.
  
  Time: ~7 hours best-estimate across Sep 3–5 sessions (diagnosis, 2 code PRs, docs PR, test gates, CI recheck, live e2e verification).
